title: Dialysis | Weekly Patient COVID-19 Vaccination | NHSN | CDC
content: Weekly Patient COVID-19 Vaccination Print Minus Related Pages Dialysis facilities can track weekly COVID-19 vaccination data for patients through NHSN. On This Page Announcements Protocol Training Data Collection Forms and Instructions CSV Data Import Resources Dialysis COVID-19 Vaccination Data Dashboard FAQs on Reporting COVID-19 Vaccination Data Announcements Timestamps in NHSN Since February 2024, timestamps in the NHSN application (such as “date created” and “date last modified” fields) have displayed Coordinated Universal Time (UTC) . UTC is the international time standard. To convert UTC to Eastern Time: Input the UTC calendar date and time into an online UTC time converter . The new UTC timestamp will have no impact on data submission deadlines. Local time remains in place for data submission deadlines. No action is needed by NHSN users. For more information on UTC, please see the following document: UTC Guidance Document_508 (cdc.gov) [PDF – 269 KB] Blast Emails None at this time. Upcoming Webinars None at this time.
